reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x00484F60 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/define/00484F60-DefineMission.cpp at sha256 bb21f9249abd710c574b87f1db6d4f37b26f05fba7037af7a602ecbd475475ba (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t DefineMission(int32_t param_1, float param_2);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

retail_function.name: DefineMission
retail_function.summary: Four blocks 0x484F60-0x484FC7: Script_EvalArgInt(frame,0), store to g_5C1590[g_5C89FC*0x4A8]; FX_ExplosionSpawn_6(value); if false, Sys_ResolveSymbol_23 for the mission fields, Script_EvalArgInt(4), two more Sys_ResolveSymbol_23 calls, memcpy of the 0x18-byte return record; else Debug_Error at 0x004AF7B0.

candidate_function.summary: Four blocks 0x484F60-0x484FC7: Script_EvalArgInt(frame,0), store to g_5C1590[g_5C89FC*0x4A8]; FX_ExplosionSpawn_6(value); if false, Sys_ResolveSymbol_23 for the mission fields, Script_EvalArgInt(4), two more Sys_ResolveSymbol_23 calls, memcpy of the 0x18-byte return record; else Debug_Error at 0x004AF7B0.

divergences: Frame pointer read from [E+8] instead of [E+0xc].
All Script_EvalArgInt/Sys_ResolveSymbol_23 calls receive the argc word.
candidate_comparison.statement: Divergences are listed above; by contract they keep the record at TRANSCRIBED or lower.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Retail entry 0x00484F60 is recovered by all three tools; the address-bound implementation is scripts/GameNatives/define/00484F60-DefineMission.cpp (sha256 bb21f9249abd710c574b87f1db6d4f37b26f05fba7037af7a602ecbd475475ba). Four blocks 0x484F60-0x484FC7: Script_EvalArgInt(frame,0), store to g_5C1590[g_5C89FC*0x4A8]; FX_ExplosionSpawn_6(value); if false, Sys_ResolveSymbol_23 for the mission fields, Script_EvalArgInt(4), two more Sys_ResolveSymbol_23 calls, memcpy of the 0x18-byte return record; else Debug_Error at 0x004AF7B0.

checks.name: abi_and_signature
checks.detail: BN int32_t(int32_t arg1, float arg2 @ 0xc): the frame is at [E+0xc]; the candidate (int context, float arg2) puts arg2 at [E+8].The retail frame slot is [E+0xc] (BN already models it as arg2/arg3 with an explicit @ 0xc offset). The candidate declaration puts its second (or third) parameter at [E+8], the registered argc slot, so the same source compiled into the QVM call site would read the wrong stack word.

checks.name: control_flow_shape
checks.detail: Retail CFG: Binary Ninja reports 4 block(s)/4 edge(s) at 0x00484F60; radare2 recovers the identical 4 block(s)/4 edge(s) (score 1.0000); angr CFGFast recovers 19 block(s) with has_unresolved_jumps=False.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: Retail calls 0x004B8A20 Script_EvalArgInt, 0x00485170 FX_ExplosionSpawn_6, 0x004AF7B0 Debug_Error and 0x004B8A80 Sys_ResolveSymbol_23 repeatedly. The candidate keeps Script_GetArg/FX_ExplosionSpawn_6/Error_Show (alias of 0x004AF7B0) but passes the argc word as the frame and therefore does not reproduce the retail string fields.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.detail: Record stride 0x4A8; field offsets 0x5C1594/0x5C15B4/0x5C16B4/0x5C16D4/0x5C17D4/0x5C18D4/0x5C19D4/0x5C19F4; sizes 0x20/0x100; return record 0x18.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: The g_5C89FC*0x4A8 record layout is preserved, but the frame source is [E+8] instead of [E+0xc]; the result record destination is arg1 ([E+4]) which is correct.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t(int32_t arg1, float arg2 @ 0xc)" at 0x00484F60; radare2 recovers "fcn.00484f60 (int32_t arg_24h, int32_t arg_28h);". Both tools place the entry at 0x00484F60 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: int32_t DefineMission(int32_t param_1, float param_2);. The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.
